<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1178
Claimant:
Jennifer Wilson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
May 10, 2023
Claimant reported a low-speed collision while backing out of a parking space in a store lot and said their left knee
struck the door frame during the impact. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and agreed to a recorded
statement.
May 13, 2023
Reviewed the vehicle photos, which show rear bumper and tail light damage consistent with the impact described. No
independent witnesses have come forward, but the responding officer's report places the claimant in the vehicle at
the scene.
May 16, 2023
Confirmed with the policy records that the driver is named on the policy and that no earlier damage to this vehicle is
on file. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates coverage.
July 4, 2023
Claimant's account has stayed the same in every conversation so far, including the initial phone call, the recorded
statement, and the follow-up email. The knee injury reported is the kind of injury expected from this type of impact.
July 31, 2023
Medical records show the knee injury was traeted over a somewhat longer period than is typical for this injury.
Records also note a minor strain in the same knee years ago that healed fully, which the treating proviedr has
accounted for in the current assessment.
December 13, 2023
Based on the photos, police report, and medical records, the damage and injury appear consistent with the described
collision. File is being routed for standard settlement review, with the longer treatment period noted for the reviewer.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
